title: MiningTrialRecord
description: One JSON Lines row appended to .autoresearch/mine/trials.jsonl

base_commit.description: Commit this trial's work branched from. Under the git-primary artifact model a proposal references base_commit -> head_commit, so recording it per trial is what lets a submission be reconstructed from the log.

head_commit.description: Commit the trial produced. Same value as git_head_after when the trial improved and was committed; null when the trial was reverted.

tree_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 tree commitment at head_commit, computed by the active settlement adapter. Stellar ABI v3 uses @openresearch/stellar-client; legacy adapters use scripts/tree_hash.py. Independent of git's SHA-1 commit ids, so a SHA-1 collision alone cannot swap the code a proposal points at.
